description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes related to Interrupt Service Routines (ISRs) in the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform. It includes ISR type definitions, resource management, and internal functions for ISR handling.

methods.name: Os_IsrAdd
methods.description: Adds a new ISR based on provided configuration.

methods.name: Os_IsrGetStackInfo
methods.description: Retrieves stack information for current ISR.

methods.name: Os_Isr_cr4
methods.description: ISR handler for ARM CR4 architecture.

methods.name: Os_Isr_cm3
methods.description: ISR handler for ARM CM3 architecture.

methods.name: Os_IsrGet
methods.description: Retrieves ISR variable structure by ID.
